label: Drivers & route sales
summary: Delivery drivers and route-sales reps running daily routes. Mobile, time-tight, often outdoors.
toneOfVoice: Brief, scannable, decision-driven. Plain language. Friendly enough to feel human but tight on word count.
readingContext: Phone, during pre-shift briefings, often standing. May read at a customer stop between deliveries. Read time: under 60 seconds for most articles.
contentGuidelines: Lead with what they need to do. Frame edge cases as 'When X, do Y' decision points. Reference DOT regulations and HOS limits accurately. Avoid corporate language; route-talk works better.
searchIntent: Drivers search on the route app between stops, typically about login, route, or vehicle issues. Queries include the app name and a specific symptom. Titles that match the error message rank highest.
